Across Yokohama.
Two lines.

Check train positions, service updates and station timetables for the Blue Line and Green Line. Plan everyday journeys with iPhone, Apple Watch and widgets.

Supported lines and operators

  • Blue Line
  • Green Line

Designed for Yokohama Municipal Subway, rather than every railway in Yokohama. Widgets use saved information and may show a different update time from the app.

Data sources

Uses data provided through the Public Transportation Open Data Center (ODPT). Information may be delayed by provider updates or connection conditions. This app is developed independently of railway and transit operators.

About ODPT ›

Have a question?

This website introduces and supports apps developed by Shimayu. The apps are independent and are not official apps of railway companies, transit operators or Apple.
Train positions and timetables may be delayed or inaccurate. For the latest information, follow station announcements and official operator information.
